_comment: Tier-2 for kratos.dem::8: MaxTimeStep is the only key that sets dt, it is used verbatim, and DeltaTimeSafetyFactor is stored and never read. Executed 2026-08-07 on Kratos 10.4.3. Measured: MaxTimeStep = 1.0 s on a case whose stable step is about 2e-5 prints 'DEM: Total number of time steps expected in the calculation: 0', leaves DELTA_TIME at 1.0, jumps to TIME 1.0, emits no warning matching 'critical time' / 'unstable' / 'too large', and exits 0; adding DeltaTimeSafetyFactor = 0.001 to the same deck changes neither DELTA_TIME nor the step count. INTERPRETER: needs a Kratos build carrying DEMApplication; set KRATOS_PYTHON=/mnt/kratos-tier2/kv/bin/python (the 28-application source build). The repo venv wheel does not import at all on this host (GLIBC_2.32 against a 2.31 system) and /usr/bin/python3 carries no DEMApplication, so pointing this anywhere else SKIPS rather than passes. Every deck is written into a fresh TemporaryDirectory and driven through DEMAnalysisStage in a CHILD process: Kratos logs from C++ and buffers it, so an in-process capture would miss every DEM line, and a Finalize()d DEM stage cannot be probed from python without segfaulting. MUTATION CONTROL (T2_MUTATE=1, re-runnable): see the module docstring -- the mutation changes the INPUT only, never an assertion, so every deck is still really executed against Kratos. Verified 2026-08-07: unmutated PASSES (rc=0) with probe_mismatches=0; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS (rc=1), the named probe lines flip and the trailing =ok line disappears. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/dem_maxtimestep_is_used_verbatim && $KRATOS_PYTHON source.py, then T2_MUTATE=1 $KRATOS_PYTHON source.py. NOTE ON forbid_in_output: the sentinel is FIXTURE_FAILED, not MISMATCH. The runner's matcher is case-insensitive substring, so forbidding 'MISMATCH' also matches the 'probe_mismatches=0' line this fixture prints on SUCCESS, and every passing run would be recorded as failed. Found by running these fixtures through scripts/run_tier2_fixtures.py rather than by hand.
